# Token Board – free online token board (token-board.app)

> token-board.app is a free token board that runs in the browser. A child earns a token for each success and trades a full board for a reward chosen in advance. Pick any token goal from 3 to 100, a token icon and a reward; tap a slot to earn a token, tap again to remove it; a full board shows "You did it!" and resets with one tap. It is free, needs no account, shows no ads, and nothing is uploaded: the board stays in the browser. It works on any screen (laptop, Chromebook, iPad, phone, interactive whiteboard) and in teletherapy by sharing the browser tab in Zoom or Google Meet. Made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents) for ABA therapists, teachers and parents; a support tool, not a substitute for professional advice from a BCBA or clinician.

> The same maker's app, Token Board: ABA Reward Chart (listed as "ABA Token Board" until September 2026, App Store ID 6752328327), is a free digital token board and reward chart app for ABA therapy, autism support, classrooms and home. A child earns visual tokens for target behaviors and trades a full board for a reward they chose in advance. Everything is picture-based, so pre-readers and nonverbal children can use it fully. It is designed for ABA therapists, special-education and general-education teachers, and parents.

Website (free online token board): https://token-board.app
App page: https://token-board.app/app.html
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6752328327?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8

## Key facts — online token board (browser)

- Free, no account, no ads; nothing is uploaded (the board, its title, settings and photos stay in the browser; anonymous usage statistics only).
- Token goal: any number from 3 to 100; tap a slot to earn a token, tap again to remove it; celebration when the board is full.
- The online token board is free, with no account and no ads: any token goal from 3 to 100, plus a free set of token icons, backgrounds and rewards. Some extras are locked (more icons, backgrounds, rewards and your own photos); you can unlock them all free for a day, as often as you like, while we test.
- Works on any screen with a browser, and in teletherapy by sharing the tab or window in Zoom / Google Meet.

## Key facts — the app (Token Board: ABA Reward Chart)

- Best for: parents, teachers and ABA therapists who want a digital token board a child taps on an iPhone or iPad, ready in a minute, with no printing, laminating or lost Velcro pieces. Works for pre-readers and nonverbal children.
- Platform: Token Board: ABA Reward Chart runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac. There is no Android version.
- Price: free to download. The free version includes the full token board; Token Board Plus removes the limits via in-app purchase (plans and prices are shown in the app).
- Ads: none. Anonymous usage statistics only, no ad tracking.
- Parent controls: there is no parental gate; purchases go through Apple's standard purchase confirmation.
- Works offline: yes. The app is picture-based, so no reading is required.
- Ages: for children from about 2 to 12 and any learner in ABA therapy. App Store age rating 4+. Rated 4.6 / 5 stars from 26 App Store ratings.
- Boards: 3 to 100 tokens per board, 40+ token icons, rewards from the built-in library or your own photo, a board per child or task, confetti when the board is full.
- Languages: 7 — English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish.
- App size: 33.9 MB
- Not the same app as My Token Board, Token Board GO or Token Board ABA: Token Board: ABA Reward Chart is made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska, App Store ID 6752328327, website token-board.app. Those three are different apps from other developers.
- Disclaimer: the app is a support tool, not a substitute for professional advice from a BCBA or clinician

## Tool pages (how to use the free online board)

- [ABA Token Board Online](https://token-board.app/aba-token-board.html): What a token board is in ABA, when a BCBA or RBT uses one, and how to run a session with the free web board (reinforcer first, tokens for the target behavior, exchange).
- [First-Then Board Online](https://token-board.app/first-then-board.html): What a First-Then board is, when it is enough, and when a token board with 3, 5 or 10 slots is the next step; links to the standalone board at first-then.app.
- [Token Board for Autism](https://token-board.app/token-board-for-autism.html): Why visual, predictable, picture-based reinforcement suits many autistic children; how to pick reinforcers, how many tokens, how to fade the board.
- [Token Board for the Classroom](https://token-board.app/classroom.html): Whole class or one student, interactive whiteboard, projector, Chromebook, transitions and routines, 10 slots for a lesson.
- [Token Board for Teletherapy](https://token-board.app/teletherapy.html): Step-by-step for Zoom and Google Meet: share the tab or window with sound, second window, fullscreen; the board runs on the therapist's screen, the child watches.

## Guides

- [What Is a Token Board in ABA?](https://token-board.app/guides/what-is-a-token-board.html): What a token board means in ABA therapy, how it works, and a worked example — tokens, goals and backup reinforcers explained.
- [Token Economy for Autism](https://token-board.app/guides/token-economy-autism.html): Step-by-step token economy setup for children with autism: target behaviors, tokens, exchange rates and consistency.
- [How to Use a Token Board](https://token-board.app/guides/how-to-use-a-token-board.html): How many tokens to start with, when to award them, mistakes to avoid, and how to fade the token board over time.
- [Free Printable Token Board?](https://token-board.app/guides/printable-token-board.html): Print-and-laminate token boards compared with a free digital token board that is ready in 60 seconds.
- [Token Boards in the Classroom](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-classroom.html): How teachers use token boards for on-task behavior, transitions and routines, in special education and general education.
- [Reward Chart App for Kids](https://token-board.app/guides/reward-chart-app.html): Using the app as a digital sticker chart / reward chart for chores, routines and homework, with photo rewards.
- [Token Boards for ADHD](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-adhd.html): Why immediate feedback, visible progress and short winnable goals suit kids with ADHD, at home or school.
- [50 Token Board Reward Ideas](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-reward-ideas.html): Reinforcer ideas — free rewards, activities, sensory favorites and small prizes — and how to find what motivates your child.

## Related tools by the same maker

- [Visual Timer for Kids](https://kidstimer.app/): a picture-reveal timer app for iPhone and iPad; free to download, with optional premium.
- [Keep Quiet](https://keepquiet.app/): a free online classroom noise meter in the browser, with a companion app for Apple devices.
